Players Committee card image of [[I Will Finish What You Started]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. Vader is lost. Once per turn, may stack an Interrupt from hand face up here to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny at Kylo's site. Kylo is power +1 for each card here. Once per game, may deploy a lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”
